maintainerHelp: Search for and select users who can maintain this contest.
languagesHelp: Leave empty to allow every available language.
ratedHelp: Include this contest in rating calculations.
autoHideHelp: Hide selected problems until the contest ends, then show them again.
autoHideUnavailable: You do not have permission to change problem visibility.
allowViewCodeHelp: Participants may view others' code after the contest.
allowPrintHelp: Participants may submit print requests during the contest.
lockHelp: Freeze the scoreboard this many minutes before the contest ends.
flexibleDurationHelp: Limit each participant to this many hours after they begin.
keepScoreboardHiddenHelp: Do not reveal the scoreboard after the contest ends.
positiveNumber: Enter a positive number or leave this field empty.
nonNegativeInteger: Enter a non-negative integer or leave this field empty.
durationInvalid: Duration must be greater than zero.
lockConflict: A contest cannot use both a scoreboard freeze and a flexible duration.
submitFailed: Failed to save the contest. Please try again later.
cloneDescription: Creates a new contest from this one. You can adjust the title and schedule before cloning.
cloneFailed: Failed to clone the contest. Please try again later.
deleteConfirm: Confirm deleting this contest? Its files and status will be deleted as well.
deleteFailed: Deletion failed. Please try again later.
